description: rig hooks — (1) run-continuity: preserve the active harness run-state across context compaction. Claude Code receives plaintext PreCompact instructions; Codex receives valid no-op PreCompact JSON and attempts a best-effort re-anchor from SessionStart(source=compact) additionalContext. (2) run-continuity-reminder: on each user prompt, if an active rig RUN is detected in the recent transcript (via the run-status header signature), re-inject the SKILL.md §6 directive so the model re-emits the header at the top of its response (backstops the prose-only directive which loses recency across many turns and tool calls). (3) continuous instinct-learning (#306): SessionStart injects high-confidence (>=0.7) learned patterns from .rig/instincts.jsonl (capped at 500 chars, separate from facets/knowledge). Automatic Stop reminders are retired; recording instincts remains an explicit manual operation.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env sh -c 'if [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then /usr/bin/env sh "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/codex-precompact.sh"; elif [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then /usr/bin/env sh "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/preserve-rig-state.sh"; fi'
